name: Leap into Justice
source:
Antonio Fuego is the new attorney in this bustling city filled with crimes and gangs.

Read as Antonio what it means to be an attorney of law with his friends and mentors in this story inspired by the Capcom’s renowned Ace Attorney series.

[From [url=http://lemmasoft.renai.us/forums/viewtopic.php?f=11&t=27629&p=332802]Lemma Soft Forums[/url]]
